note: Ratchet baseline for the in-progress board (router v5 content; the board on main is unchanged since b5c2b57). CI fails the DRC step only if a count RISES above these numbers (regression, or the checker changed behaviour) or if the DRC tool/report itself is broken. Counts at or below the baseline are reported as board state, never as 'DRC passed'. When routing completes (0 violations, 0 unconnected), set both counts to 0: the same step then acts as a hard zero-tolerance DRC gate again, with no code change.
